triage.fix_rationale: Running npm audit fix updates the vulnerable resolved versions in package-lock.json. package.json may need bumps (e.g. @angular/* beyond 22.1.0) if a direct range blocks the fix.
triage.hypothesis: npm audit at --audit-level=high found newly disclosed advisories in transitive and direct packages (piscina critical; undici, brace-expansion, browserslist, fast-uri, js-yaml high). The locked versions in package-lock.json are vulnerable, and fixes are available.
